content: HTML popover attribute / Popover API reached Baseline 'Newly available' as of January 2025, supported in all current major browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) since ~April 2024. Provides declarative top-layer overlay behavior (light-dismiss, Esc-to-close) without manual z-index/backdrop/focus-trap code. Safe to use for a 2026 offline single-file game; older/legacy browsers unsupported but out of scope for this project's target environment.
